mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG")"

# Task-local snpEff config for the custom Arabidopsis thaliana reference
# genome_version key chosen from the exact reference/annotation release,

data.dir = $DATA_DIR/data
$GENOME_VERSION.genome : Arabidopsis thaliana custom reference
EOF

  "$CONFIG"; do

echo "config=$CONFIG"

before_full_public_candidate.code:
set -euo pipefail

INPUT_GTF="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part2.vairant_annotation/data/genome.gtf"
INPUT_FASTA="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part2.vairant_annotation/data/genome.fasta"
INPUT_CONFIG="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/biomind_agent_benchmark/runs/task_outputs/session_1789563666/plan_artifacts/snpeff/snpEff.config"

WORKSPACE="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/biomind_agent_benchmark/runs/task_outputs/session_1789563666/plan_artifacts/snpeff"
JAVA_BIN="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/source_tools/temurin-21/bin/java"
SNPEFF_JAR="/public/home/liusiqi/anaconda3/envs/bio_gatk/share/snpeff-5.3.0a-0/snpEff.jar"
CONFIG="$INPUT_CONFIG"
DATA_DIR="$WORKSPACE/data"
GENOME_VERSION="arabidopsis_thaliana_custom"
GENOME_FASTA="$DATA_DIR/genomes/${GENOME_VERSION}.fa"
GENES_GTF="$DATA_DIR/${GENOME_VERSION}/genes.gtf"
PREDICTOR="$DATA_DIR/${GENOME_VERSION}/snpEffectPredictor.bin"
BUILD_LOG="$DATA_DIR/${GENOME_VERSION}/build.log"

for p in "$JAVA_BIN" "$SNPEFF_JAR" "$CONFIG" "$GENOME_FASTA" "$GENES_GTF"; do
  if [ ! -s "$p" ]; then
    echo "missing required input: $p" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
done

# Approved read-only inputs for this step (staged layout already validated by prepare_database).
for p in "$INPUT_GTF" "$INPUT_FASTA"; do
  if [ ! -s "$p" ]; then
    echo "missing approved step input: $p" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
done

mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR/${GENOME_VERSION}"

BUILD_RC=0
"$JAVA_BIN" -jar "$SNPEFF_JAR" build -gtf22 -v -c "$CONFIG" -dataDir "$DATA_DIR" -noCheckCds -noCheckProtein "$GENOME_VERSION" > "$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || BUILD_RC=$?

echo "BUILD_INNER_RC=$BUILD_RC"
echo "--- build.log tail ---"
tail -n 40 "$BUILD_LOG" || true
echo "--- end build.log tail ---"

PREDICTOR_EXISTS=false
PREDICTOR_SIZE=0
if [ -s "$PREDICTOR" ]; then
  PREDICTOR_EXISTS=true
  PREDICTOR_SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$PREDICTOR")
fi

FATAL_MARKER=false
if grep -q "Database check failed" "$BUILD_LOG"; then
  FATAL_MARKER=true
fi

READY=false
if [ "$BUILD_RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PREDICTOR_EXISTS" = true ] && [ "$FATAL_MARKER" = false ]; then
  READY=true
fi

echo "PREDICTOR_EXISTS=$PREDICTOR_EXISTS PREDICTOR_SIZE=$PREDICTOR_SIZE FATAL_MARKER=$FATAL_MARKER READY=$READY"

export BIOMIND_BUILD_RC="$BUILD_RC"
export BIOMIND_PREDICTOR_EXISTS="$PREDICTOR_EXISTS"
export BIOMIND_PREDICTOR_SIZE="$PREDICTOR_SIZE"
export BIOMIND_FATAL_MARKER="$FATAL_MARKER"
export BIOMIND_READY="$READY"
export BIOMIND_BUILD_LOG="$BUILD_LOG"
export BIOMIND_PREDICTOR="$PREDICTOR"
export BIOMIND_GENOME_VERSION="$GENOME_VERSION"
export BIOMIND_INPUT_GTF="$INPUT_GTF"
export BIOMIND_INPUT_FASTA="$INPUT_FASTA"
export BIOMIND_INPUT_CONFIG="$CONFIG"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os

build_rc = int(os.environ["BIOMIND_BUILD_RC"])
predictor_exists = os.environ["BIOMIND_PREDICTOR_EXISTS"] == "true"
predictor_size = int(os.environ["BIOMIND_PREDICTOR_SIZE"])
fatal_marker = os.environ["BIOMIND_FATAL_MARKER"] == "true"
ready = os.environ["BIOMIND_READY"] == "true"

facts = {
    "produces_observations": {
        "snpeff_database_ready": {
            "value": ready,
            "genome_version": os.environ["BIOMIND_GENOME_VERSION"],
            "build_inner_returncode": build_rc,
            "predictor_path": os.environ["BIOMIND_PREDICTOR"],
            "predictor_exists": predictor_exists,
            "predictor_size_bytes": predictor_size,
            "database_check_failed_marker": fatal_marker,
            "build_log_path": os.environ["BIOMIND_BUILD_LOG"],
            "annotation_gtf_path": os.environ["BIOMIND_INPUT_GTF"],
            "reference_fasta_path": os.environ["BIOMIND_INPUT_FASTA"],
            "snpeff_config_path": os.environ["BIOMIND_INPUT_CONFIG"],
            "optional_validation_skipped": ["cds_check", "protein_check"],
        }
    }
}
print("BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON=" + json.dumps(facts, ensure_ascii=False))
PY

if [ "$READY" != "true" ]; then
  echo "database build did not satisfy acceptance criteria" >&2
  exit 4
fi
